summary.text: Randy Parks is the Republican candidate for the Kansas House of Representatives, District 104, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democrat Lynnette Krieger-Zook; no incumbent is seeking the seat.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he is a current county commissioner and a lifetime resident of Hutchinson.

paragraphs.text: Randy Parks earned a high school diploma from Hutchinson High School and an associate degree from Hutchinson Community College, and Ballotpedia lists his profession as car dealer.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he spent much of his life in management and has been married 45 years.
Parks advanced unopposed from the August 4, 2026 Republican primary, receiving 3,359 votes.

He described himself as fiscally conservative and said he wants to reduce state overspending and taxes and to see improvements in schools; he named taxation, water and corrections as policy interests.
He listed endorsements including Kansas Farm Bureau, Kansas for Life, Kansas Family Voice and the NRA Kansas Rifle Association.
